# AI system design

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/ai-system-design.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

End-to-end design of AI products and platforms, explained aloud with requirements, trade-offs and failure modes.

## Both tracks

- **Design a knowledge assistant over ten million enterprise documents with per-user permissions and a continuously changing corpus.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †, [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) †, [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †, [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether ingestion, retrieval, access control and serving form an operable system.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Clarify query volume, freshness and permission semantics before sizing.
    - Separate ingestion and index versions from query-time authorisation and retrieval.
    - Evaluate grounded answers and test revocation, stale data and partial outages.
  - Read: [Document-level access control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-document-level-access-overview) (Microsoft Learn) · [Contextual Retrieval in AI Systems](https://www.anthropic.com/news/contextual-retrieval) (Anthropic)
- **Design a customer-support agent that can execute service actions and transfer the case to a human when needed.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether execution authority and human escalation are part of the architecture.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Map supported intents to explicit tools and permission boundaries.
    - Use observed operation outcomes and persistent case state to prevent duplicate actions.
    - Define escalation triggers and transfer enough context for a human to continue.
  - Read: [Building Effective AI Agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) (Anthropic) · [Writing effective tools for AI agents—using AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/writing-tools-for-agents) (Anthropic)
- **Design a moderation system that combines specialist classifiers and LLMs while controlling delay and review workload.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether risk classes, escalation and false decisions shape system design.
- **Design an LLM gateway with provider routing, failover, caching, rate limits and enforceable spending budgets.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †, [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) †
  - Tests: Whether provider differences and failure handling preserve the service contract.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Define provider capabilities and normalise only compatible request semantics.
    - Enforce tenant quotas and budgets before dispatch, including retries.
    - Specify failover boundaries for partially streamed responses and side-effecting tool calls.
  - Read: [Scaling your API with rate limiters](https://stripe.com/blog/rate-limiters) (Stripe) · [Designing robust and predictable APIs with idempotency](https://stripe.com/blog/idempotency) (Stripe)
- **Design a secure developer API for model access, including authentication, quotas, streaming responses and backwards compatibility.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether a model endpoint is treated as a durable platform contract.

## AI Engineering

- **Design a repository-aware coding assistant, from indexing and context assembly to applying edits and checking results.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether code context, safe edits and task evaluation are connected.
- **Design semantic search for a large product catalogue, including relevance measurement and rapidly changing inventory.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether semantic relevance is combined with valid catalogue constraints.
- **Design a pipeline that extracts structured fields from ten million scanned documents and makes uncertain results reviewable.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether extraction quality, provenance and scalable processing are planned together.
- **Design natural-language querying over a warehouse with thousands of tables, from schema selection to safe query execution.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) †, [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether semantic correctness and query permissions constrain generation.
- **Design a meeting assistant that records discussion, distinguishes speakers and publishes summaries and action items to connected tools.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †
  - Tests: Whether audio processing, attribution and integration reliability fit together.
- **Design a streaming chat service for hundreds of millions of users, including capacity, conversation storage and graceful overload behaviour.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †, [Google and Google DeepMind](../companies/google.md) †, [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †, [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether scale assumptions lead to explicit capacity and reliability decisions.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Estimate concurrent streams, token demand and storage from declared traffic assumptions.
    - Separate admission control, inference scheduling and durable conversation state.
    - Plan capacity headroom, cancellation, overload rejection and recovery from partial failure.
  - Read: [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google) · [Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180) (Kwon et al., arXiv)
- **How would you support multiple questions within one conversation while keeping turn ordering and shared context consistent?**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether concurrent conversation updates have clear consistency semantics.
- **Design distributed search for a billion documents at a million queries per second; state your partitioning and capacity assumptions.**
  - System design · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
  - Tests: Whether indexing, fan-out and tail latency are grounded in estimates.
- **Design reliable delivery of events to customer webhook endpoints despite timeouts, duplicate attempts and unavailable receivers.**
  - System design · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
  - Tests: Whether delivery guarantees and consumer responsibilities are stated precisely.
